name: broker-desk
description: Broker Desk: a CRM for Canadian MCA brokers, with calling, a multi-line dialer, texting, email sequences and dashboards. Cloudflare Pages + D1 + R2.

scripts.test: node scripts/test-twilio.mjs && node scripts/test-api.mjs && node scripts/smoke.mjs
scripts.deploy: node scripts/seed-demo.mjs --export public/demo-data && wrangler d1 migrations apply broker-desk --remote --env production && wrangler pages deploy --project-name broker-desk --branch main
